brief: Owner-supplied brief (17 November 2026, repeated on 19 November: 'add new according to previous prompt'): research, write, optimise and publish one high-quality article; no fabricated metrics; analyse at least five competitors; report limitations.

targeting.title: ollama ps Explained: What SIZE, PROCESSOR and UNTIL Mean
targeting.metaTitle: ollama ps Explained: SIZE, PROCESSOR, UNTIL
targeting.metaDescription: What ollama ps shows: SIZE, PROCESSOR, CONTEXT, RUNNER and UNTIL explained, why it says Stopping or 4 minutes from now, and why the list is sometimes empty.
targeting.excerpt: Every column of ollama ps explained from the Ollama 0.40.16 source: what SIZE and PROCESSOR measure, how the UNTIL countdown works, why it reads 4 minutes from now or Stopping, and seven reasons the list can be empty.
targeting.keywords: ollama ps, ollama ps explained, ollama ps meaning, ollama ps until meaning, ollama ps until stopping, ollama ps shows nothing, ollama ps is empty, ollama ps command, ollama ps size, ollama ps 100% cpu, ollama ps processor, ollama stop model, ollama unload model, ollama keep alive
targeting.summary: ollama ps lists the models loaded in memory; SIZE is memory in use, PROCESSOR is the CPU and GPU split with the CPU share first, and UNTIL is the time before unloading|UNTIL cuts minutes instead of rounding, so a fresh five minute timer reads 4 minutes from now, and Stopping means the expiry time has passed while a reply is still running|An empty table is normal once the keep-alive runs out; other causes are a different server, a cloud model or a name filter that matches nothing
targeting.author: Ali Rehman

siteAnalysis.finding: Stored views on 19 November: Gemini not showing 45, how to run AI locally 23, Ollama not using GPU 18, Ollama models folder 15, Cursor stuck planning 15. The 12 n8n posts published since 31 October have 0 to 9 views each. The Ollama connection guide (post 256) is one day old and has 0 views, which says nothing yet. The Ollama cluster is the only recent cluster with steady views, so this article extends it. The stored view counter is the only first-party signal available and may include non-search visits.

siteAnalysis.cannibalization: Four posts mention Ollama: run AI locally (install overview), GPU not used on Windows, models folder on Windows, and the connection error guide. The GPU post tells readers to run ollama ps but does not explain the table. No existing post targets the ollama ps command, the UNTIL column, Stopping or an empty list.

research.notUsed: Google Trends, paid keyword tools and Search Console were not available. No search volume or keyword difficulty figures are stated anywhere.

keywordMap.intent: Informational with a problem-solving edge. The reader has run ollama ps, sees a label or an empty table and wants to know what it means and whether something is wrong.

rejectedCandidates.evidence: Broad autocomplete footprint (network access, remote access, expose to network, listen on all interfaces, over network). Nine ranking pages were audited in docs/content-research/2026-11-19-competitors-network.json.
rejectedCandidates.reason: Several recent dedicated guides already cover the environment variable, firewall rules, the app setting, security and tunnels (mljourney updated 24 October 2026, blackmoreops updated 6 November 2026, pocketgrove updated 3 November 2026, serverman, munimv2). The remaining gap is narrow: the exact Host header rule and the app toggle replacing a custom port. Kept as a later supporting article, not the best opening for a small site today.

queries.ollama ps until meaning: Two GitHub issues first, then command cheat sheets, the one-line official CLI page and one Chinese-language post. No dedicated English explanation of the column.
queries.ollama ps shows nothing: Two GitHub issues, general troubleshooting guides, GPU guides and a Facebook answers page. No page about the empty table itself.
queries.ollama ps command output explained: Command cheat sheets and the official CLI page. One guide (bigiron.cc) reads the PROCESSOR column in depth.
queries.ollama ps 100% cpu meaning: Crowded with GPU troubleshooting guides. This article does not compete on GPU tuning and links to the existing GPU post instead.

competitors.gap: No page explains the UNTIL wording (why 4 minutes, Forever, Stopping), the rules that restart the countdown, the causes of an empty table, the undocumented name filter, the release in which each column arrived, or links any of it to the source code. The strongest competitor is deep on PROCESSOR with real measurements, so this article keeps PROCESSOR to the exact label rules and does not claim measurements.

images.origin: Original ByteVerse illustrations rendered from SVG with sharp. The cover is a title card with an example table in a terminal mock-up, not a screenshot. The inline diagram of the countdown is drawn from the 0.40.16 scheduler code and was reviewed against it. No stock photography.

validation.latestReleaseCheck: gh api repos/ollama/ollama/releases/latest returned v0.40.16 on 19 November 2026; 0.40.17 exists only as release candidates.
validation.columnHistory: Binary search over the 273 stable release tags, reading cmd/cmd.go at each step: ps command absent 0.1.37, present 0.1.38; stop command and Stopping label absent 0.3.10, present 0.3.11; CONTEXT absent 0.9.6, present 0.10.0; RUNNER absent 0.35.1, present 0.40.0. There is no stable tag between 0.35.1 and 0.40.0.
validation.powershellCheck: The Invoke-RestMethod line was run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 on Windows 11 Pro build 26300 against a local test server that returned the article's example JSON on /api/ps. It printed name, size, size_vram, context_length and expires_at. Ollama was not involved.
validation.faqSchemaNote: Six FAQs are visible; the site-wide FAQPage JSON-LD uses the first five.

originalityAudit.method: Case-normalised five-word phrase overlap; code blocks, tables and links excluded. Compared with the 188 stored posts, 15 saved official Ollama documentation files, the ten competitor pages fetched for this topic, and the 16 competitor pages saved for the two earlier Ollama audits.
